messages:
alex: heads-up, p95 for /v1/uploads jumped from ~120ms -> ~880ms around 12:05 UTC, alert 'ingress-queue-depth' fired. seeing increased 429s and queued requests. anyone oncall?
infra-bot: ALERT: ingress-queue-depth > 500 for service uploads-service (since 2026-03-17T12:06:02Z) — see https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/ingress-queue-depth
mira: looking now — I can see queue length ~620 and inflight workers pegged. pods show CPU ~94%/mem stable.
raj: did we have a deploy around that time? checking deploy history...
sam: deploys: canary rollout uploads-service v2.3 started 12:03 UTC (canary traffic 10%).
mira: that canary looks suspect — the canary hosts are handling disproportionately more small requests and causing more context switches + queueing.
raj: can you paste the top few lines from the worker logs? wondering about backpressure/retries.
mira: pasted snippets: ```Mar 17 12:05:21 worker-3 uploads: warn: processing-latency 720ms queue=12 inflight=48
Mar 17 12:05:27 worker-3 uploads: error: admit_timeout: request dropped after waiting 1500ms
Mar 17 12:05:29 worker-2 uploads: info: started request batch_size=1 cache_hit=false
```
sam: running quick kubectl to validate: ```kubectl get hpa -n prod uploads-service
NAME             REFERENCE             TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS
uploads-hpa      Deployment/uploads     85%/80%   3         12        10
```
alex: looks like HPA hit max replicas and pods are still CPU bound, admission controller is queueing. we need an immediate mitigation: either scale up base replicas, throttle incoming traffic, or rollback canary.
ops-lead: i'm going to increase replica cap and temporarily raise admission concurrency for uploads service to relieve queueing. doing that now.
mira: suggested quick patch to admission config map to increase per-pod concurrency_limit from 50 -> 80 and admission_timeout from 1500ms -> 2000ms (temporary). applying with kubectl.
raj: note — this is a workaround, we should still investigate why v2.3 increases per-request CPU.
infra-bot: ACTION: configmap/admission-config updated by ops-lead at 12:12 UTC, replicas increased to 14 via hpa override.
mira: after changes p95 is down to ~180ms, queue length ~40. seeing fewer 429s.
sam: rolling canary back to v2.2 on remaining canary pods to be safe.
ops-lead: rollback started. ops-note: canary frequency will be disabled until postmortem.
alex: nice work team. please capture repro steps and collect flamegraphs for v2.3. I'll open a follow-up PM/incident ticket.
raj: will grab flamegraphs + perf profile from canary host and attach.
mira: adding dashboards to the ticket and a quick checklist for admission tuning.
alex: marking thread resolved for now — monitoring for 30m. :thumbsup:
